description: Indiana Traffic Signal Hi Resolution Data Logger Enumerations is a data set deposited in Purdue University Research Repository by its authors James R. Sturdevant, Timothy Overman. This document defines the enumerations used to encode events that occur on a traffic signal controllers with high resolution data loggers. The time resolution is to the nearest 100 milliseconds. Background information on the development of high resolution controller data in Indiana can be found at: Smaglik E.J., A. Sharma, D.M. Bullock, J.R. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2012. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
